verdict.description: accurate is the expected outcome. falsified: a stated claim is not true of the code. underscoped: the bound excludes something that governs the behaviour.

confirmed.description: Claims you actually went and checked, and which held.

findings.description: Empty when the verdict is accurate. Every entry must cite what it falsifies.

cites.description: The exact property or observation text this refutes. Never empty.

evidence.description: file:line references that support the refutation.
